pictures.name: CTR1-Runaway-Children
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The great stone walls and round towers of Ávila, Spain, around 1522, on a sunny morning. In the middle, a little girl of about seven with dark curls and dark expressive eyes, in a simple blue dress, walks hand in hand with her slightly older brother in a brown jerkin, both determined and smiling, carrying a small bundle of bread, along a dirt road away from the city gate. Wild flowers by the road. Warm gold light, deep blue sky. Innocent, brave, a little funny. Safe and gentle. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CTR2-Uncle-Road
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A sunlit walled garden in a Spanish house in Ávila, around 1522. In the middle, the same little girl with dark curls in a blue dress and her brother in a brown jerkin kneel, laughing, stacking small stones into a tiny hut that is tumbling down. At the garden gate behind them, a kind uncle in a dark cloak and a relieved mother in a black lace mantilla look on, smiling. Warm gold light, deep blue shade under orange trees. Gentle humor, home. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CTR3-Convent-Clock
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A bare stone convent chapel in Ávila in the 1540s, afternoon. In the middle, Teresa of Ávila, a lively Spanish woman with dark expressive eyes and a round warm face, in a brown Carmelite habit with a white wimple and a black veil, kneels at a wooden prayer stool with hands folded but eyes sliding sideways toward a tall wooden clock on the wall, a little restless and weary. Other nuns kneel in the dim background. A shaft of gold light from a high window, deep blue shadows. Honest struggle, a touch of humor. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CTR4-Friend-Prayer

A small simple convent cell in Ávila at evening: a plain wooden cross on the whitewashed wall, a straw mat, one candle. In the middle, Teresa of Ávila, a lively Spanish woman with dark expressive eyes and a round warm face, in a brown Carmelite habit with a white wimple and a black veil, sits on a low stool, relaxed and leaning forward, smiling warmly and speaking as if to a dear friend; across from her an empty wooden chair glows softly in the candlelight. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows. Intimacy, peace, friendship. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CTR6-Cart-River
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A muddy river crossing on a rough road in the Spanish countryside, rainy evening. A wooden mule cart has tipped at the edge of the shallow brown water; in the middle, Teresa of Ávila, a lively Spanish woman with dark expressive eyes and a round warm face, in a brown Carmelite habit with a white wimple and a black veil, older now, sits in the shallow muddy water, safe and unhurt, her veil askew, looking up at the stormy sky with a wry, amused, exasperated expression as if speaking to God. Two nuns on the bank hurry to help, laughing. Gold light breaking through grey-blue clouds. Humor, honesty. Safe, gentle. No text, no letters, no logos.
